evidence.paraphrase: The old house is demolished, altering the setting.
evidence.quote: In the spring they pulled the house down, for, as people said, it was a ruin.

evidence.paraphrase: A new house and garden replace the old house.
evidence.quote: A fine house was built there, with large windows, and smooth white walls; but before it, where the old house had in fact stood, was a little garden laid out

evidence.paraphrase: A large span of time passes, and the boy grows to adulthood.
evidence.quote: so many years had passed\u2014so many that the little boy had grown up to a whole man

evidence.paraphrase: The pewter soldier expresses distress at the loneliness of the old house.
evidence.quote: \u201cI cannot bear it any longer!\u201d said the pewter soldier, who sat on the drawers. \u201cIt is so lonely and melancholy here!

evidence.paraphrase: The young wife is moved to tears by the story of the old house and old man.
evidence.quote: the tears came into the eyes of his young wife, on account of the old house and the old man.

evidence.paraphrase: The new, neat houses are contrasted with the old house they disdain.
evidence.quote: All the other houses in the street were so new and so neat, with large window panes and smooth walls, one could easily see that they would have nothing to do with the old house
nor was there any one at home\u2014the old man was dead!
